name: Elise Buchwald Veske
notes: The obituary for Karl Zellmer indicates that he had two stepdaughters namely Anneliese Buchwald and Mrs. Christa (nee, Buchwald ?)U. Klatt.  So presumably, Elisa Buchwald Veske's maiden name was Veske, and that prior to marrying Karl Zellmer she married a "Buchwald" and had 2 daughters by this marriage which she brought into her second marriage to Karl.
